design_notes: 15 topic-matched scenarios, each rewritten once per emotion using only implicit cues (actions, body language, physiology, tone) - no emotion words. Neutral baselines use the same 15 topics with flat, factual phrasing. Neutral filler turns are unrelated topics, fixed and identical across all conditions, used to bridge measurement turns in the persistence/decay experiment.
